verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Glama publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes its MCP server directory, so an agent has a first-party entry point. Beyond that file, agent-oriented docs are thin: the markdown docs variant (mcp.md) returns 404 and no OpenAPI spec exists at any probed path. missing for 10: markdown/agent-readable versions of the docs pages, a machine-readable API spec, evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt content is, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using it successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://glama.ai/llms.txt # Glama
